# DUM-SDK 0.15.2

## Releases

- Name the client mod in releases and builds `DUM-SDK-Fabric-X.Y.Z.jar` (with `DUM-SDK-Fabric-X.Y.Z.jar.sig`) next to `DUM-SDK-Paper-X.Y.Z.jar`, and label the release files "Fabric mod (client)" and "Paper plugin (server)". The self-updater looks for the new name and installs the update into `mods/` under it.

## Upgrade and validation

The wire protocol stays at 6, so 0.15.2 clients and Paper plugins work with 0.15.0 and 0.15.1 ones in any combination. Clients up to 0.15.1 look for `DUM-SDK.jar` in a release and do not update themselves to 0.15.2: install `DUM-SDK-Fabric-0.15.2.jar` into `mods/` by hand once and remove the old `DUM-SDK.jar`; later updates find the new name. Updating the Paper plugin is optional, it has no functional changes.

Local macOS verification: the unit tests and `./gradlew build`, which produces `DUM-SDK-Fabric-0.15.2.jar` and `DUM-SDK-Paper-0.15.2.jar`, and the GitHub Build workflow. The self-update from 0.15.2 to a later release, Windows/Linux clients, the players' full modpack and the live VDS remain unchecked.
